title: Distributed Unique ID Generator
vague_prompt: Design a unique ID generator for distributed services.
hidden_guidance: 10 million IDs per second at peak across all services
IDs must be unique across data centers and must never be reused
IDs must be roughly time ordered so that a range scan over a 1 hour window reads few pages
Generation must not need a network round trip per ID, and a local call must answer in under 1 ms
Every ID must fit in 64 bits
The system must tolerate a clock that moves backwards by up to 5 seconds
known_patterns: Snowflake style 64 bit layout with timestamp, worker id, and sequence
Worker id assignment from ZooKeeper or a config service
Clock skew handling with a wait or a sequence bump
K-sorted IDs that are ordered within a small window
No coordination on the hot path, only at node startup
UUIDv7 as the alternative when 128 bits are acceptable
common_misses: Worker id collision when a node restarts with a new address
ID bits leaking volume or exact time to clients
Timestamp bit width and the year the ID space runs out
